definitions: To live your life in a particular way, especially one that you have planned or dreamed of.
To spend the rest of your life in a particular place or situation.
To reside away from one's place of work or study, especially when accommodation is provided on site.
examples: She always wanted to live out her days by the sea.
He's determined to live out his dream of becoming a musician.
Most students live out, only a few stay in the dorms.
